description: Revoke one of your API keys by its first 12 characters (key_prefix), as listed by account_api_keys, or every key on the account at once (all: true). A revoked key stops working immediately and cannot be restored. Scoped to your account: needs an email sign-in at /mcp/account. A request made with an API key cannot revoke keys. Free.

all.description: true revokes every key on the account at once. Give this or key_prefix, not both.

key_prefix.description: The first 12 characters of the key to revoke, as listed by account_api_keys. It starts with afk_. Give this or all, not both.

response_detail.description: summary (the default) returns a short text reply. full returns the whole result as JSON text.

name: account_api_key_revoke

artifact.description: Inline generated file artifact. downloadUrl is a private link to the same file that works for 15 minutes; after that only contentBase64 remains.

contentBase64.description: Base64-encoded artifact content to decode and save locally.

downloadExpiresAt.description: When downloadUrl stops working (ISO 8601), 15 minutes after the call.

downloadUrl.description: Private download link for this file, valid until downloadExpiresAt. Give it to the user when they ask for the file.

name.description: Suggested file name for the artifact.

type.description: Artifact document type such as pdf or docx.

artifact_summary.description: Delivery and rendering metadata for an inline generated artifact.

delivery.description: How to retrieve or save the generated artifact.

downloadUrl.description: Hosted download URL when one exists; null when the artifact is inline only.

documentType.description: Rendered artifact type such as pdf or docx.

fileName.description: Suggested file name for the generated artifact.

artifacts.description: Artifact rendering hints keyed by format.

bucket.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: the limit that was reached.

limit.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: the daily limit.
